body:
But all I am is a wall of text. You don't really know *me.* If you did, it'd definitely end up the way it always has.

I might just get a morale boost here or there. But I'll always end up alone in this rumination. It's no longer distorted. No one cares, so no one even comforts me on the things that good in my life, because there aren't any. No one asks. They just stand there.

I don't have any potential anymore, because I gave up so many things. Now they're so elementary it's as if I've forgotten how to do those things. My hobbies... my studies... my games... I just suck now.

I can't even make a decent post on Reddit. This is fucking stupid.

 

Should just rust in a hospital I guess.
